Title: A. Center School District Vision and Mission -  Board President Calvin

fields.Content:
Our Vision: 

“Ensure each student thrives in a future -focused learning environment as they build their skills becoming responsible citizens.”

Our Mission:

fields.Content: The Assistant Superintendent of Accelerated Learning recommends the Center Board of Education approve the partnership with the University of Kansas to participate in the GEAR UP federal grant competition. The grant would provide funding for a seven-year program to support academic success, college readiness, and family engagement for the district’s sixth and seventh-grade students (class of 2031 and 2032)
